title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via best-fit character mapping in…
description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The flaw arises from best-fit character mapping in Perforce settings, allowing an attacker with limited privileges to execute arbitrary code remotely without user interaction.
